media_alt: A monochrome generative study channeling Bauhaus geometry: stark contrast, precise forms, and disciplined composition.
challenge: Stripping Bauhaus-inspired geometry down to its purest expression through a monochrome palette. The challenge was to create compositions where shape, contrast, and spatial balance carry the entire visual weight without relying on color, demanding precision in every edge and proportion.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to generate core geometric forms and compositional layouts, then refined each piece for edge quality, contrast discipline, and spatial balance. The monochrome constraint required particular attention to tonal range and form clarity throughout the finishing process.
result: Delivered a six-piece monochrome Bauhaus collection with crisp, high-contrast panels that perform equally well at small tile scale and large print format. The series demonstrates disciplined restraint and clean geometric thinking suited for gallery walls and design portfolios.
